findings.title: High Severity Vulnerability in lodash
findings.description: The project uses lodash 4.17.20, which has a known high severity vulnerability (GHSA-35jh-r3h4-6jhm) affecting the project.
findings.recommendation: Update lodash to a version that is not affected by the GHSA-35jh-r3h4-6jhm vulnerability.

result.summary: The project contains a high severity vulnerability in lodash. This vulnerability has been known for some time and can lead to potential security risks. It is recommended to update lodash to a version that is not affected by this vulnerability.
